description: Plavic于1923年推出的折叠相机。配备Plavic-Anastigmat135mm f/6.3, Aperture range f/6.3-f/32, filter slip-on。快门速度Gitzo leaf shutter type B1, with speeds: 1/25, 1/50, 1/100 +T & B.The Gitzo shutter was labelled 'Plavicos' on some models of Plavic cameras.。Bellows focusing, index and scale on the left-inside of the front cover, Focus range: 1-10m +inf.。
